Unless stated otherwise, every item can only be purchased once by each model. Any model with access to the Armory and the Mark of Khorne equipped can buy as many items as it wants. Items with a cost of "-" can not be selected.
Models in Terminator armor can only receive equipment marked with ᵀ.
Everytime the model kills an enemy Character model, a Monstrous Creature or a Vehicle, it gains +1 Strength and +1 Attack for the rest of the game.
Once per game, the model may use a "Stand & Shoot" order to be immediately removed from the battlefield and deployed via Deep strike rules.
The unit can dispel 1 psychic power per battle round.
The model gains +6" Movement, +1 Toughness, +2 Wounds, +1 Attack and the "Bike" unit type. Only for infantry.
The model gains +1D3 bonus attacks for a charge move, instead of just 1.
The model gains Deadly(5+) on one of its weapons. If the weapon already has the rule, increase Deadly(x+) by 1. For example Deadly(5+) becomes Deadly(4+).

Once per game, when this model activates, this model and any attached unit may gain Mindless and improve their A characteristic by 1. Lasts until this model's next activation. Only for <Cultist> units.
Psykers within 18" suffer a "Perils of the Warp" attack on each double when trying to manifest a psychic power. Additionally, they have to roll two dice and apply both peril results. Unique.
The model and its attached unit gain the "Blind Rage" ability. Roll 2D6 for Blind Rage and take the higher result.
If this model used an Advance or Charge order this turn, psykers within 12" suffer a -1 penalty when attempting to manifest psychic powers.
Models in Terminator armor can only receive equipment marked with ᵀ.

Roll 1D6 during each activation in close combat. On a 3+ you gain the rolled number as additional Attacks. On a 1 or 2 the additional attacks are directed at friendly models in direct base contact. If there are no friendly models, it will attack itself. Unique.
Whenever the model successfully performs a Charge order against an enemy vehicle, immediately inflict a Glancing hit with AT(2) against that vehicle.
If this model successfully pursues an enemy unit after winning Melee Combat, inflict automatic hits according to the rules of Tank Shock, treating the distance travelled as 6.
